description: The Kiribati National Statistics Office published a Census Atlas in 2022 that maps results of the November 2020 Population and Housing Census, which was collected with tablets and SPC support. Its 37 maps show indicators by island, with village maps for Abaiang, North and South Tarawa and Kiritimati and enumeration area maps for Betio. The housing and services maps cover roof and wall materials, household solar electricity, cooking fuel, access to improved drinking water, internet access and waste disposal. The atlas reports that across 20,354 households, 17 rural islands had 75 percent or more of households using solar power for lighting and electricity, while South Tarawa still relies mainly on the diesel-based grid. Coverage is national across the island groups. Format and access: free PDF, no registration; the census data page lists a report, an island profile table and the questionnaire, and microdata are linked from the Pacific microdata library. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: values are shown as maps and charts, not tables; the census data page said tables were still being finalised. Simulation uses: off-grid solar coverage and water access by atoll for energy and climate adaptation planning. Related records: the SPC Pacific Data Hub record has household counts for Kiribati.
